name: eventoren

scripts.build: bun run boundary:check && bun run legal:compile && bun run content:process:local && bun run content:compile && vite build && bun run boundary:check && bun run ssr:worker && bun run ssr:check
scripts.upload: bunx wrangler pages deploy dist/client --project-name eventoren --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.test:convex: bun run convex codegen --system-udfs --typecheck disable && bunx vitest run --config vitest.convex.config.ts
scripts.convex:dev: export CI=1 && bun run convex dev --env-file=.env.development
scripts.convex:dev:local: export CI=1 && bun run convex dev --local
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run shared-ui:check && bun run content:check && bun run boundary:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.content:process: bun run assets:prepare && bun run src/app/content/contentProcess.ts -- --content-section=ratgeber --sync --strict
scripts.content:process:local: bun run assets:prepare && bun run src/app/content/contentProcess.ts -- --content-section=ratgeber --strict
scripts.content:process:init: bun run assets:prepare && bun run src/app/content/contentProcess.ts -- --content-section=ratgeber --sync --resync --strict
scripts.content:clean:sync: bun run content:clean && bun run content:process:init
scripts.content:check: bun run content:process:local && bun run src/contentCheck.ts
scripts.seo:check: bun run src/seoOutputCheck.ts && bun run src/contentOutputCheck.ts
scripts.www-redirect:create: bunx wrangler pages project create eventoren-www-redirect --production-branch=main
scripts.deploy:www-redirect: bunx wrangler pages deploy . --cwd src/www-redirect --project-name eventoren-www-redirect --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.assets:upload: ASSETS_ENV_FILE="${ASSETS_CLI_ENV_FILE:-$HOME/.config/project-creator/assets/eventoren/assets-cli.env}" bun run assets upload-all . --integration-note "Update project assets" --wait --json
scripts.frontend:build:development: env -u PUBLIC_BASE_URL_SITE -u PUBLIC_BASE_URL_APP -u PUBLIC_BASE_URL_API -u PUBLIC_BASE_URL_CONVEX -u VITE_CONVEX_URL -u VITE_CONVEX_SITE_URL -u CONVEX_SITE_URL -u CONVEX_URL -u CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_URL bun --env-file=.env.development run build
scripts.frontend:build:production: env -u PUBLIC_BASE_URL_SITE -u PUBLIC_BASE_URL_APP -u PUBLIC_BASE_URL_API -u PUBLIC_BASE_URL_CONVEX -u VITE_CONVEX_URL -u VITE_CONVEX_SITE_URL -u CONVEX_SITE_URL -u CONVEX_URL -u CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_URL bun --env-file=.env.production run build
scripts.frontend:deploy:preview: bun run frontend:build:development && bun run frontend:upload:preview
scripts.frontend:deploy:production: bun run frontend:build:production && bun run frontend:upload:production
scripts.frontend:create: bunx wrangler pages project create eventoren --production-branch=main
scripts.deploy:preview: bun run frontend:deploy:preview && bun run backend:deploy:development
scripts.deploy:production: bun run backend:provision:production && bun run backend:deploy:production && env -u PUBLIC_BASE_URL_SITE -u PUBLIC_BASE_URL_APP -u PUBLIC_BASE_URL_API -u PUBLIC_BASE_URL_CONVEX -u VITE_CONVEX_URL -u VITE_CONVEX_SITE_URL -u CONVEX_SITE_URL bun --env-file=.env.production run convex:verify && bun run frontend:deploy:production
scripts.convex:verify: bun run convex codegen --system-udfs --typecheck disable && bun run scripts/verifyConvexPublicProjectInfo.ts

description: A public Solid website built with Adaptive DS.
